item.title: WATCH: American B-52 bombers take off toward Iran
item.description: CENTCOM has published footage of B-52 Stratofortress bombers taking off and heading toward Iran, where they struck Iranian ballistic missile centers and command-and-control posts across the country. The post WATCH: American B-52 bombers take off toward Iran appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Israelis more optimistic despite escalating war with Iran, survey finds
item.description: The data show that the share of Israelis reporting high concern for their personal safety rose from 22 percent before the war to 45 percent afterward. The post Israelis more optimistic despite escalating war with Iran, survey finds appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Drastic decrease in Iranian missile attacks since start of war
item.description: The drop in both missile and drone launches does not mean the threat has disappeared, as even a small number of successful strikes can cause significant damage or disrupt daily life.
